a.lede: WIRED is tallying up how many times Nvidia’s interim CEO has assured everyone that the company has everything under control.
a.title: Does Nvidia Got This? Interim CEO Colette Kress Says It’s Got This

b.lede: If Nvidia is backstopping a data center loan, it won't be on the hook unless the neocould has independent financing and gets the facility built, with Nvidia gear installed, interim CEO Colette Kress explained.
b.title: Nvidia clarifies when it will — and won’t — keep financing neoclouds
